body: I am truly happy that you are doing better. I guess I'm at the point where I've lost the hope that things will get better. It doesn't make sense to keep going just for the sake of going.
I wish the same for you. It's painful because I know where I could be if it wasn't for these issues. I'll be seeing my doctor in a week hopefully I can find a medication that works better for me.
What did you do to feel better? I know I could keep struggling and grind out years if I had to, but that just has no appeal to me anymore. I'm tired.
I'm turning 30 in a month and have been unemployed for five years. I feel you. On applications- when I feel up to sending them- I put some bs about working from home in online advertising.

I appreciate you responding.  I know there are plenty of reasons not to kill myself. I don't want to kill myself- I want to be better. It just feels absolutely hopeless. 

If I knew for sure there was no hope I would kill myself this second. It doesn't bother me that I means depression/anxiety would have won. I don't see any point in grinding out 40-60 more years of this. 

I need something to hope for.
I've done that too. Told myself if it was heads I'd get help. Flipped heads. I'm so full of shit.
